cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring that empty box to my desk, please. Carry out the instruction before adding anything to it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was a question. I asked for a box. Let's complete one instruction correctly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back. Without the question this time, please.
